description: Amp, Droid and Junie under their previous npm names, and Kimi Code's archived Python CLI.
why: The old names are what machines installed before each move still report. @sourcegraph/amp now installs @ampcode/cli as a nested dependency, and forbid_rows holds that nested copy absent as a global, so Amp here is found through the old name alone. Junie's postinstall also writes ~/.local/bin/junie, so must_contain pins the package row. kimi-cli's uv tool directory is Kimi Code's only witness here, and @moonshot-ai/kimi-code is held absent so the old name is what finds it.
known_gaps: kimi-cli is never run, so whatever state directory the Python CLI wrote is unexamined.
